facts.title: improvement notice - critical control at TX-9001

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the proving zero energy before intrusive work on TX-9001 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically inspecting and maintaining portable equipment. TX-9001 (mine switchgear) is in service for pit and workshop distribution. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the proving zero energy before intrusive work had been bypassed. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 24 December 2019 a regulatory notice was issued concerning TX-9001 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop following commissioning of replacement equipment.
